description: This PHP class `SystemConfigurationHelper` provides methods to retrieve system configuration details such as OS info, PHP version, server info, MySQL version, and application version for the OrangeHRM system. It is used for gathering environment details related to the system where OrangeHRM is deployed.

classes.name: SystemConfigurationHelper
classes.description: Helper class to retrieve system environment details such as OS, PHP, MySQL, server info, and application version

methods.name: getSystemDetailsAsArray
methods.description: Returns an array containing detailed system information including OS, PHP, MySQL, server, and OHRM version

methods.name: getOsDetails
methods.description: Returns an array with OS details obtained from php_uname

methods.name: getServerDetails
methods.description: Returns server software details from the $_SERVER superglobal

methods.name: getMySqlDetails
methods.description: Returns MySQL client and server version details

methods.name: getOHRMDetails
methods.description: Returns application version details from the Config class

methods.name: getSystemDetailsAsJson
methods.description: Returns the system details as a JSON encoded string

methods.name: getMySqlServerVersion
methods.description: Retrieves MySQL server version via Doctrine ORM's native connection attributes
